SELECT R.RNO, R.COMPANY, R.EMP, R.ONO, U.NAME, U.BIRTHDATE FROM TBL_ROOM R JOIN TBL_USER U ON R.EMP = U.UNO WHERE R.COMPANY = #{cno}
SELECT r.RNO, r.COMPANY, r.EMP, r.ONO, c.corpNm FROM TBL_ROOM r LEFT JOIN TBL_CINFO c ON r.COMPANY = c.uno WHERE r.EMP = #{uno}
SELECT o.o_title AS o_title, o.o_tag AS o_tag, o.o_content AS o_content, o.o_regdate AS o_regdate, NULL AS user_content, NULL AS user_regdate FROM tbl_offers o WHERE o.ono = #{ono}
